plan: An exorcist who marks his targets with nails and can finish off weakened enemies with his ultimate.
aSurveiller: His R (Purgatory). He throws an artefact that can execute the enemies it hits: when you are low on health, move away.
contrer: When low on health, back off: his R can execute you.
Dodge his nails (Q): they mark you for his attacks.
During his W he hurts himself: wait until he has lost health before engaging.

sorts.P: His attacks hurt more on wounded targets.
sorts.W: Speed in exchange for health, healing afterwards.
sorts.E: Teleports then dashes to his target.
